set.game[title]: PSX Character Library: 29 Low Poly Packs + Every New One
set.game[short_text]: 29 PSX character packs, 405 rigged 3D characters. Every new pack added free.
set.game[description]:
Every CSAF PSX character pack in one download: 29 packs, 405 rigged low-poly characters for Godot, Unity and Unreal, $236.71 if bought one by one. Every new pack we release is added here on its launch day, free for everyone who owns the Library. Royalty free for commercial games.

New here first: Bloom: 14 PSX Space Horror Infected Crew, added in v1.15.0 (2026-11-27). That makes 29 packs on this page.

How the future packs work

  • Each new CSAF PSX character pack is added here on its launch day.
  • You do not pay again: the new files appear in your itch.io library.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here.

$19.99 now. Buy once, keep every pack that joins. The price may rise for new buyers as the library grows; any rise is announced here with its date.

Making a PS1 style horror game? Horror Manor is our 42 track PSX survival horror music pack. Dread is our horror sound effects pack.

What every pack contains

  • three or four palette skins per character, 1228 skinned entities in all, one 256 px texture per skin, 1492 to 1500 triangles per character.
  • One 53-bone humanoid skeleton and the same 45 animation clips on every character (walk, run, idle, crouch, jump, punches, sword, pistol, spell, hits, death, sit, swim and more), plus a T-pose.
  • Per character: a GLB for each skin (the first carries every clip), an FBX with clips, an OBJ, the textures and the Blender source.
  • The PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snap, affine textures, 15-bit colour, dither, fog).
  • Eight Angles also ships every enemy as 8-direction billboard sprite sheets for retro shooters.

Compatibility: Godot 4 (tested: a blank 4.7.2 project imported one random pack from each of the eleven archives), Blender 5.2, and the standard humanoid FBX route for Unity 6 and Unreal 5 (not run here).

Downloads

Eleven archives, one per genre above. Extract them into one folder and they merge into one tree, each pack in its own folder as its page ships it. A manifest lists every file with its checksum.

Licence

You can use every model, texture and clip in any number of commercial and non commercial games, with no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. You cannot resell or redistribute the files themselves as assets.

Made with AI: the bodies come from MakeHuman (CC0 output) driven by AI written scripts, every texture is an AI painting projected onto the model, and each pack names its image model in its NOTICE file. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library. No audio.

Free first

One character from every pack is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Want a theme we have not made yet? Ask on the Request Desk. For anything else, post a comment below. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these characters were made. A line you can adapt: "Some 3D characters in this game come from a third party asset library; their textures were painted by an AI image model and their bodies were built by scripts written with AI tools."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.
